description: This file defines an Angular service 'OtaPackageService' for managing OTA (Over-The-Air) packages, including CRUD operations, file uploads, downloads, and confirmation dialogs related to OTA updates.

classes.name: OtaPackageService
classes.description: Angular service for OTA package management, including fetching, saving, deleting, uploading, and user confirmation dialogs.

methods.name: getOtaPackages
methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of OTA packages.

methods.name: getOtaPackagesInfoByDeviceProfileId
methods.description: Retrieves OTA package info filtered by device profile ID and update type.

methods.name: getOtaPackage
methods.description: Fetches a specific OTA package by ID.

methods.name: getOtaPackageInfo
methods.description: Fetches detailed info of an OTA package by ID.

methods.name: saveOtaPackage
methods.description: Saves an OTA package, handling file upload if present.

methods.name: uploadOtaPackageFile
methods.description: Uploads a file for an OTA package.

methods.name: deleteOtaPackage
methods.description: Deletes an OTA package by ID.

methods.name: countUpdateDeviceAfterChangePackage
methods.description: Counts devices that will be updated after changing the OTA package.

methods.name: confirmDialogUpdatePackage
methods.description: Displays a confirmation dialog before updating OTA package settings, showing affected device counts.
